In each reaction, free-radical substitution occurs.

Which row is correct?
stem_lead:
Two hydrocarbons, CH₃CHC(CH₃)CH₃ and CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃, react separately with chlorine in the presence of ultraviolet light.

In each reaction, free-radical substitution occurs.

Which row is correct?

options.A: identity of the hydrocarbon that can also undergo electrophilic addition: CH₃CHC(CH₃)CH₃; a termination stage of the free-radical substitution of the saturated hydrocarbon: CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₂• + Cl• → CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₂Cl
options.B: identity of the hydrocarbon that can also undergo electrophilic addition: CH₃CHC(CH₃)CH₃; a termination stage of the free-radical substitution of the saturated hydrocarbon: CH₃CHC(CH₃)CH₂• + Cl• → CH₃CHC(CH₃)CH₂Cl
options.C: identity of the hydrocarbon that can also undergo electrophilic addition: CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃; a termination stage of the free-radical substitution of the saturated hydrocarbon: CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₂• + Cl• → CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₂Cl
options.D: identity of the hydrocarbon that can also undergo electrophilic addition: CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃; a termination stage of the free-radical substitution of the saturated hydrocarbon: CH₃CHC(CH₃)CH₂• + Cl• → CH₂CHC(CH₃)CH₂Cl

a termination stage of the free-radical substitution of the saturated hydrocarbon
